Use as GM-only texture unless table play earns it. True grail The Sable Sinecure A logistics guild that makes impossible forest transport look polished, expensive, and deserved. The Sable Sinecure™: danger, properly accounted. The Sable Sinecure™ makes moving freight through a deadly forest look so polished you forget the danger is the product. The Sable Sinecure™ presents as old-money competence: lacquered route maps, a hazard-rate ledger displayed like a wine list, agents in sable-and-silver who quote your survival odds with a sommelier's confidence. Buy a Certified Safe Passage™, a Hazard-Indexed™ premium route, a membership tier that makes paying more for the same trees feel like taste. It is a Kazrak™ franchise wearing heritage like cologne. Every cache mark and danger rating is real, and every one of them exists to prove that knowing the forest is a luxury good, and you are renting it. A neat cache mark has been cut into the bark where only a trained eye would look. It is useful, smug, and almost certainly...
